definitions.explanation: A suffix attached to nouns indicating being completely absorbed in or indulging in that activity. Often used for leisure or enjoyable activities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{読書三昧|どくしょざんまい}→読書三昧：17319_dokushozanmai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spent the holiday immersed in reading.

examples.japanese: お⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{贅沢三昧|ぜいたくざんまい}→贅沢三昧：17878_zeitakuzanmai⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: New Year's was a time of total indulgence.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧{三昧|ざんまい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I spend every day absorbed in video games.

notes:
{三昧|ざんまい} comes from Buddhist terminology ({三昧|さんまい}) meaning deep meditation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{読書三昧|どくしょざんまい}→読書三昧：17319_dokushozanmai⟧: absorbed in reading
- ⟦{贅沢三昧|ぜいたくざんまい}→贅沢三昧：17878_zeitakuzanmai⟧: living in luxury
- ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧{三昧|ざんまい}: absorbed in games
- ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧{三昧|ざんまい}: indulging in alcohol
- ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧{三昧|ざんまい}: indulging in hot springs

USAGE:
This suffix typically implies enjoyment and satisfaction in the activity, though it can sometimes carry a slightly self-indulgent or excessive nuance.
